description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amended Gazette Extraordinary No. 2166/35 of 13th March 2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the issuance of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, which establishes new customs duty rates for specific petroleum products. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of import duties and falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, nor does it focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, so it does not qualify for the government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
